documents.title: Audited financial statements
documents.text:
Audited financial statements — Esker Industries (fictional).
In this document "EIH" means Esker Industries. Esker AB reports net debt of $373.5m for FY2024 on a reported basis. Esker Industries reports approximately capex of $37m for FY2025 on a reported basis. Esker Industries reports cash margin of 4.5% for FY2025. Esker Industries reports revenue of $716m for FY2025 on a reported basis. For Esker Industries, the treatment of restructuring add-backs is read as: add-backs limited to costs incurred within 12 months. For Esker Industries, the sponsor equity cure is: no equity cure right.

documents.title: Lender presentation
documents.text:
Lender presentation — Esker Industries (fictional).
Esker Ltd reports net debt of $427.2m for FY2024 on a reported basis. Esker Industries reports capex of $38.4m for FY2025 on a reported basis. Esker Industries reports available liquidity of $47.8m for FY2025 on a reported basis. Esker Industries: interest cover for FY2024 — not provided. For Esker Industries, the treatment of restructuring add-backs is read as: add-backs include expected future synergies. For Esker Industries, the sponsor equity cure is: equity cure available twice over the life of the facility.
